status: registered before any match of this study was run; development measurement, NOT a formal acceptance and NOT a G-A8 result
authority: Owner 2026-11-01 item 5 (P6: fresh-seed development exclusion study)
question: Which choices should be offered on classic.m3 / m7 / m8 under template table v21.b1? The current rows were measured on the shipped configs of those templates.

scope.selectionRule: mechanical, from code, no results seen: every live (dimension, choice) with a registered claim that is structurally offered on the template under v21.b1, not covered by an unscoped template "*" row, and at least one of: A an existing row keyed to that template; B it is the weak batch of the current truth plan; C it has the smallest knob delta among non-std templates under v21.b1 (same formula as the truth plan); D it is newly offered under v21.b1 compared to the shipped config
scope.outOfScope: "*" rows: std-level decisions (n=400 replication or std primary rows), unchanged by a template fix. classic.m7 lanes.top.stance=split and classic.m8 phases.late.objectiveOrder=baron are keyed rows also covered by a "*" not_replicated row, so they stay withheld whatever this study would say and are not measured

seeds.note: fresh block never used by any study; tool path, each seed its own effectiveSeed

design: same as truth-table weak batches: blue = the template with the choice, red = std, control = the template with no choice on the same seed, mirrored roster, items standard, skills on; blue arm only (red replication is out of scope for a development study)

decisionRule.metricAndDirection: the registered claim of the row given the template's own choice under v21.b1 (claimFor), never chosen after seeing data
decisionRule.offer: paired z in the claimed direction >= 2 with n >= 20 (TRUTH_GATE.minZ)
decisionRule.noEffect: |z| < 2: row keyed templateBalance "v21.b1" with reason no_measured_effect
decisionRule.reversed: z against the direction <= -2: row keyed "v21.b1", reason reversed_effect
decisionRule.unmeasurable: n < 20 or z null: withheld, reason unmeasurable
decisionRule.noRetries: no re-run, no seed swap, no metric swap, no seed dropped; errored seeds follow errorRule (> 1% STOP)

application.shippedRows: an existing keyed row whose choice is offered by this study gets templateBalance null: it keeps withholding on shipped configs (v20 and any table-less path, unchanged) and no longer applies under v21.b1. A row still failing stays unkeyed
application.newRows: every failing choice without a row gets a new row keyed "v21.b1"
application.v20: must leave the v20 offer lists, v20 golden and Challenge byte-identical; verified by a gate

limits: multiple comparisons are not corrected, same as the truth table; a development decision. The formal truth-table re-run after the freeze is registered separately (stage1_formal_acceptance_registration_3aB.json)
